Ādama stāsts

Reinsone, Sanita. Ādama stāsts. Life, customs and habits in Mazsalaca in Ā. Purmalis’s autobiography at the turn of the 20th century. Riga: Zinātne, 2008 (second edition, 2011). “Ādama stāsts” was staged at the Latvian National Theatre, directed by Indra Roga (premiere: 2011).
